user.title: Connect RemoteRelay
user.description: Recommended: use Zeroconf auto-discovery when the RemoteRelay desktop app is running on the same LAN. If discovery does not appear, use manual setup with host and port.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: Use the IP/hostname and port shown in RemoteRelay Desktop > Integrations > Home Assistant.

pair.title: Pair RemoteRelay
pair.description: In RemoteRelay Desktop, enable Home Assistant and copy the current pairing code. Then enter it here for {name} ({host}:{port}).

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate RemoteRelay
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant can no longer authenticate with {name} ({host}:{port}). Generate a fresh Home Assistant pairing code in RemoteRelay Desktop and enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the RemoteRelay daemon.
error.pairing_not_enabled: Pairing is not enabled in RemoteRelay. Open the desktop app, enable Home Assistant and refresh the pairing code.

abort.already_configured: This RemoteRelay device is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: A RemoteRelay setup flow is already running. Close the current dialog first, then retry.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the RemoteRelay daemon.
abort.not_supported: The discovered service is missing required RemoteRelay metadata.
abort.wrong_device: The discovered RemoteRelay endpoint belongs to a different device. The existing Home Assistant device was not changed.
abort.wait_for_discovery: This wizard does not keep waiting in background. Steps: (1) Open RemoteRelay Desktop, (2) enable Home Assistant, (3) in Home Assistant wait for the discovered device notification, or use manual setup with host/port.
